text: Dates and counts from the sculpture's story as a known digit key: the dedication, the fall of the Berlin Wall, Carter's breach, the Morse padding counts, the letter counts of K1 to K4.
Subtracting the digits leaves the word's letters forced. Across 46,400 cases no word shorter than 26 letters fits.
The best forced word scores -5.86, below the best on a shuffled copper. None of these numbers is the second key.
